name: Nectar Lifescience Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Nectar Lifesciences Ltd manufactures APIs and Formulations[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NLL is a research-driven manufacturer 
of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients, intermediates, and finished dosage 
forms, specializing in anti-infectives 
like Cephalosporins. It also serves 
as a CMO for global pharma 
innovators.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.47 times its book value
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 61.2 days to 43.0 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -6.77% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -5.50% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 98.8% of their holding.
